name: compliancehub-internal
description: Inspect ComplianceHub status, prepare a verified brief, and post it only with explicit delivery intent.

interface.shortDescription: Verified compliance status and daily Slack briefs
interface.longDescription: Securely inspect internal ComplianceHub readiness, risks, evidence health, monitoring findings, and leadership reports. Preparing is read-only by default. An Owner can deliver one fact-checked daily brief to the configured Slack channel only after explicit delivery intent or from the trusted hosted scheduled-post task.
defaultPrompt: Prepare today's verified compliance brief without posting.
Post today's verified compliance brief to the configured Slack channel.
Show the compliance items needing attention.
Get the latest leadership compliance report.
